comodidades.h2: Pools, Fireplace, Cinema and Two Gourmet Areas.
comodidades.sub: Plus an optional team of 3 to 5 people to cook, tidy and serve.
comodidades.a.title: Pools and Fireplace
comodidades.a.text: Ground-floor infinity-edge pool with a heated hydromassage. Heated upper pool, with hydromassage, on the living room veranda. Eco-friendly alcohol fireplace by the pool, for 12 people.
comodidades.b.title: Gourmet Areas
comodidades.b.text: Ground floor: gas grill, beer cooler, ice maker and pizza oven. Upper floor: charcoal grill, beer cooler, ice maker and wine cellar.
comodidades.c.title: Cinema and Gym
comodidades.c.text: 4K projection on a 120-inch screen, 5.1 surround sound and electric reclining seats, with streaming, for 10 people. Gym in the house.
comodidades.d.title: Comfort
comodidades.d.house.t: Wi-Fi, kitchen, workspace, beach access, loungers by the pool and private parking for 12 cars, 6 covered.
comodidades.d.suites.t: Minibar, TV, electric curtains and air conditioning.
comodidades.d.condo.t: 24-hour security and 2 pedestrian gates to the village.
comodidades.e.title: Optional Team
comodidades.e.text: Cook, housekeeper and bartender, in a team of 3 to 5 people. Daily rates from R$ 270 to R$ 320, depending on the role. Charged separately.
head.title: Casa Koray | Beach House in Praia do Forte, Bahia
head.description: Beachfront holiday home for up to 25 guests in Praia do Forte: 10 suites, infinity-edge pool, home cinema and Tivoli Beach in front. Book direct.
core.wa.default: Hello! I saw the Casa Koray website and would like to know more about the house.
depoimentos.caption: rating on Airbnb, from 3 reviews
depoimentos.feh.short: “This house is perfect for hosting a large group… everyone could enjoy time together and also have privacy.”
depoimentos.feh.full: “This house is perfect for hosting a large group. We were four families and a few more friends, and everyone could enjoy time together and also have privacy. The team’s support was incredible and every meal was impeccable.”
depoimentos.renaldo.short: “The house is exactly as in the listing photos, with an incredible view of the sea… simply a private five-star resort.”
depoimentos.renaldo.full: “The house is exactly as in the listing photos, with an incredible view of the sea, extremely cozy, very polite and helpful staff - simply a private five-star resort.”
dianoite.h2: When the Day Ends, the House Lights Up.
dianoite.lead: Warm light on the wooden ceilings, a lit pool and the eco fireplace beside it.
dianoite.dia.p: Loungers beside the infinity-edge pool, with the sea just ahead.
dianoite.ent.p: Low light reaches the deck, the lawn and the lit pool.
dianoite.noi.p: The eco fireplace is lit by the pool and gathers up to 12 people.
faq.item.valor.a: From R$ 13,000, with a 4-night minimum. The final price and availability are confirmed on WhatsApp.
faq.item.pessoas.q: How many people does the house host?
faq.item.pessoas.a: Up to 25 guests, in 10 suites with 13 bathrooms.
faq.item.horarios.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.item.horarios.a: Check-in at 12 pm and check-out at 12 pm.
faq.item.cobrancas.q: What is charged besides the daily rate?
faq.item.cobrancas.a: Water, electricity and gas, by use, and a refundable PIX deposit.
faq.item.equipe.a: Yes, as a paid option: cook, housekeeper and bartender, in a team of 3 to 5 people. Daily rates from R$ 270 to R$ 320, depending on the role.
faq.item.reserva.a: Direct on WhatsApp, or through Airbnb and VRBO.
faq.item.praia.q: Is the house close to the beach and the village?
faq.item.praia.a: It faces Tivoli Beach, 1 minute on foot. Praia do Forte village is 5 minutes on foot and Projeto Tamar 15. Salvador Airport is 1 hour by car.
faq.item.estacionamento.a: Yes, private, for 12 cars, 6 of them covered.
faq.item.seguranca.a: Yes, 24 hours, with two pedestrian gates leading to the village.
